mapper.select: SELECT /* LGSYSC00070.retrieveTop10ListForMain */ LSU.SYSTEM_CODE ,LSU.MENU_ID ,LMM.MENU_NAME ,PROGRAM_ID ,URL_ADDR ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 1, 'Y', 'N') FROM LGCOM_USER_MENU_AUTHO_V LU WHERE LU.APPLICATION_USER_ID = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND LU.MENU_ID = LSU.MENU_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS MENU_AUTHO_FLAG FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_USER_FAVORITES_N LSU ,LGCOM_MENU_M LM ,LGCOM_MENU_MULTI_LANG_N LMM WHERE LSU.MENU_ID = LM.MENU_ID AND LM.MENU_ID = LMM.MENU_ID AND LMM.LANGUAGE_CODE = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND LSU.FAVORITES_CREATION_CLASS_CODE = 'SYSTEM_EACH_LOGGING' AND LSU.SYSTEM_CODE = UPPER( #{USER_SESSION.systemCode} ) ORDER BY LSU.SORT_ORDER_NO

SELECT /* LGSYSC00070.retrieveFavoriteList */ system_code ,menu_id ,menu_name ,program_id ,DECODE(item_type,'USER_SELECT_FAVORITE','SELECTED','ALL') as item_type ,sort_order_no FROM( SELECT men.system_code , fav.menu_id , lmm.menu_name , men.program_id , fav.favorites_creation_class_code AS item_type , fav.sort_order_no AS sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_USER_FAVORITES_N fav , LGCOM_MENU_M men , LGCOM_MENU_MULTI_LANG_N lmm , ( SELECT application_user_id , org_id , menu_id FROM ( SELECT a.application_user_id , a.role_code , NULL AS org_id , b.menu_id FROM lgcom_user_role_n a , lgcom_role_menu_n b WHERE a.role_code = b.role_code AND a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND NVL(a.apply_start_date,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(a.apply_end_date,SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N WHERE role_code = a.role_code AND organization_type_code = 'C') UNION SELECT urn.application_user_id , urn.role_code , rbo.company_id AS org_id , rmn.menu_id FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N urn , LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N rbo , LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N rmn WHERE urn.role_code = rbo.role_code AND urn.role_code = rmn.role_code AND rbo.organization_type_code = 'C' AND urn.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND NVL(urn.apply_start_date,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(urn.apply_end_date,SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE ) GROUP BY application_user_id, org_id, menu_id ) orm WHERE fav.menu_id = men.menu_id AND men.menu_id = lmm.menu_id AND lmm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND fav.application_user_id = orm.application_user_id AND fav.menu_id = orm.menu_id AND fav.favorites_creation_class_code IN ( 'USER_SELECT_FAVORITE') AND fav.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND (orm.org_id IS NULL OR orm.org_id = #{USER_SESSION.defaultOrgId} ) UNION ALL SELECT m.system_code ,m.menu_id ,m.menu_name ,m.program_id ,'ALL' item_type ,seq sort_order_no FROM (SELECT row_number() over(ORDER BY access_date DESC) AS seq ,menu_id ,access_date FROM (SELECT a.menu_id ,MAX(access_date) AS access_date FROM lgcom_system_access_logging_n a ,lgcom_menu_m m WHERE a.execution_yyyymm = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyymm') AND a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND a.menu_id LIKE 'M%' AND a.menu_id = m.menu_id AND m.use_flag = 'Y' AND m.display_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY a.menu_id )) x ,(SELECT lmm.system_code, lmm.menu_id, lmn.menu_name, lmm.program_id FROM lgcom_menu_m lmm , lgcom_menu_multi_lang_n lmn WHERE lmm.menu_id = lmn.menu_id AND lmn.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ) m WHERE x.menu_id = m.menu_id AND x.seq <= 10 ) ORDER BY item_type, sort_order_no
mapper.insert: INSERT /*LGSYSC00070.insertFavoriteItem*/ INTO LGCOM_SYSTEM_USER_FAVORITES_N ( APPLICATION_USER_ID ,MENU_ID ,SYSTEM_CODE ,FAVORITES_CREATION_CLASS_CODE ,SORT_ORDER_NO ,CREATED_BY ,CREATION_DATE ,LAST_UPDATED_BY ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ,#{menuId} ,( SELECT SYSTEM_CODE FROM LGCOM_MENU_M WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId} ) ,'USER_SELECT_FAVORITE' ,( SELECT NVL( MAX(SORT_ORDER_NO) + 1 , 1 ) FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_USER_FAVORITES_N WHERE APPLICATION_USER_ID = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ) ,#{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE ,#{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ,SYSDATE )
